content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. degree holders in Science or Engineering (or those having their thesis submission certificate), with expertise in experimental condensed matter physics. The applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years. Age limit: Below 35 years (as on the last date of submission of the application) Age relaxation: As per funding agency norms Other conditions: Open to Indian Nationals only Desirable: Background in development of magnetic thin films and heterostructures Spin-orbit torque measurements and analysis Basic understanding of quantum materials and their potential applications in spintronic technologies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given on the following sheets of the notice. Attach a detailed CV, an overview of PhD/Postdoc work, a list of publications/patents on a separate sheet, copies of degree and certificates and a recommendation letter. Combine everything into a single consolidated PDF file. Write "Application for Postdoctoral Position, your name" in the email subject. Send the email to [email protected] or [email protected] by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Postdoctoral Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years (as on the last date of submission of the application). Relaxation: As per funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship Rs. 75000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. degree holders in Science or Engineering (or those having their thesis submission certificate), with expertise in experimental condensed matter physics; PhD completed within the past 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian Nationals only.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who completed their PhD more than 5 years ago. Candidates aged 35 years or above on the last date of submission, subject to relaxation as per funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Online interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for one year. Extendable up to 1.0 year based on performance or until the project's completion, whichever is earlier. Selected candidate must join immediately (within a few days) after receiving the offer letter, as per Institute joining rules.
